answer:
The performer of "Mingus Three" is **Charles Mingus**, a renowned jazz bassist and composer. He was born in **Nogales, Arizona**.

The largest populated city in the state of Arizona is **Phoenix**.

The winner of the most recent IndyCar race (the Good Ranchers 250 at Phoenix Raceway, held on March 7, 2026) was **Josef Newgarden**. He drove the No. 2 XPEL Team Penske Chevrolet to victory in that event.
